title: 2026 Q1~Q3 work review - Karen Shen

slides.title: 2026 Q1–Q3 Work Review
slides.notes: Open with the scope of this review: work recorded through September 21, focused on organizational contribution rather than a task inventory.

slides.title: Scaling Design Capability

content.statement: Design capability is scaled across Design, AI, MKT, and partner teams.

slides.notes: Position the role as an organizational bridge that turns design expertise into shared systems used across Design, AI, MKT, and partner functions.

slides.title: Two bridges, one scaling model

columns.heading: Designers ↔ AI workflow
bullets: Build shared knowledge and adoption confidence
Provide the right context and review safeguards
Operate reliable access, tools, and handoff routines

columns.heading: Visual Designers ↔ MKT
bullets: Translate visual direction into reusable templates
Deliver ready-to-use assets and production guidance
Use evidence and feedback to improve quality

slides.notes: The role scales capability through two connected bridges: enabling designers to work with AI, and turning visual direction into reliable MKT delivery.

slides.title: Internal education: build a shared AI operating language
slides.notes: This is the education layer of the Designers-to-AI bridge. The goal was to create a shared operating language before asking designers to adopt new tools or workflows.

rows: Six-week curriculum for Git, collaboration, PR review, and recovery
31-slide sharing on tool boundaries and designer handoff
Bilingual guides, setup checks, and adoption support
Made AI design capability visible and discussable

slides.title: Internal tools: turn adoption into reliable operating capacity

rows: Visual diff and design-token checks; 5 review cycles and 40/40 E2E
L1/L2 reference sync and session-level context loading
Unified model, credential, launcher, and recovery flow
Portable interview toolkit: 8 interviews and 18 machine-test records

slides.notes: This is the tools layer: design-pr-review, design-context, AI access management, health checks, and handoff safeguards make adoption dependable after education has established the shared language.

slides.title: Visual Designers ↔ MKT: research, templates, and delivery assets

rows: 85 images, 14 trilingual survey cards, and design-language synthesis
9 documented mockup templates and guided content generation
Blind evaluation and stakeholder feedback mechanism
75 verified assets exported from 4 production Figma sources

slides.notes: Show the sequence behind MKT delivery: 85 images and 14 survey cards informed the design language; template guidance made that language reusable; the Figma export tool delivered 75 verified production assets.

slides.title: Shared workstreams extend each project’s value

rows: Shared onboarding, governance, data, and team operations
Shared instructions across 22 projects; 20 clean pushes
12-slide reference demo for assessing delivery quality
Evidence matrix, token ledger, and self-hosting plan

slides.notes: Make internal work visible. Sharing and tools are leverage: they reduce repeated explanation, standardize quality, and allow design capability to travel between projects and teams.

slides.title: Active work continues across platform, pipeline, and operations

rows: Open Design evaluation and TLDS pipeline
Self-hosting POC, design-system routing, assembly, and verification
Template metadata, asset sync, and delivery guidance
Access, profiles, skills, and cross-runtime continuity
Context loading and design-to-delivery handoff alignment

slides.notes: These are not future ideas; they are active responsibilities with explicit next steps. This is important for reorg evaluation because the work includes continuing platform and operations ownership.

slides.title: Retain the bridge

content.statement: Design Engineering makes AI and MKT delivery reliable, scalable, and governed.

slides.notes: Close with the reorganization lens: the function owns systems that make design capability scalable.

purpose: 呈現 Design Engineer 的個人貢獻，以及其形成的團隊可持續能力
desiredAction: 納入 reorg 評估，理解設計部門內部仍承擔的工具、流程與專案工作
